notes: Program is the BS in Computer Science and Engineering (College of Engineering). No CS1 is in the required core: CSE 2221 is the first required programming course, entered via CSE 1222/1223/1224/ENGR 1281 or placement, so it fills C1 and CSE 2231 fills C2. C3 is CSE 2331 (data structures and algorithms, the required algorithms course). Ohio State's university-level syllabus guidance (Office of Undergraduate Education) and Code of Student Conduct are outside this course layer.
